newsitem.title: USA: Baker Hughes acquires Drilex Int'l.
newsitem.headline: Baker Hughes acquires Drilex Int'l.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said Monday it completed its acquisition of Drilex International Inc after securing the approval of Drilex shareholders.
Baker Hughes is exchanging 0.4013 of a share for each Drilex share. A total of 6.8 million of Drilex shares on a fully diluted basis will be exchanged for 2.7 million shares of Baker Hughes.
Shares of Baker Hughes were down 13/16 at 43 early Monday afternoon.
Drilex provides products and services used in directional drilling of oil and natural gas wells. It also makes, sells and rents mud motors.
Banker Hughes provides products and services for the oil, natural gas and process industries.
